queries: SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE invoice_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type COLLATE BINARY <> 'Payment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: An invoice qualifies when it has at least one transaction whose type is not exactly 'Payment'; its total includes all transactions, including Payments.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only the transactions whose type is not exactly 'Payment'.
